 Thunder vs Hawks predictions, picks
 Justin Martinez: OKC 115, Atlanta 109
 OKC has struggled to defend on the perimeter this season, and it'll now face an Atlanta team that ranks fifth in the NBA in 3-point attempts per game (43.1%). But the Hawks rank just 22nd in 3-point percentage (33.8%), so the deciding factor will be whether they can catch fire from distance. I'm betting against that happening since two of their better shooters, CJ McCollum and Kingston Flemings, have been ruled out. Give me the Thunder at home in a reunion with Lu Dort and Aaron Wiggins.
